title: About Agent Atlas
body: Agent Atlas is a proposed discovery and research layer for BasedAgents. It connects agent companies, products, MCP servers, skills, protocols and task services.

The aim is to help readers understand what a project claims to do, what evidence exists and what still needs testing. An organization, a product and a protocol are separate records, even when they belong to the same ecosystem.
This release combines source-linked descriptions with editorial evaluation guides. It contains no newly executed agent tasks, security audits or payment tests.

title: How the atlas handles evidence
body: We distinguish source inspection from runtime testing. A vendor page supports an attributed product claim; it does not establish successful execution.
Every profile carries source links and an observation date. Numerical prices retain units and notes about extra costs. Funding events remain separate from cumulative funding and valuation.
Unknown means not established by the inspected sources. It must not be rendered as No, unsupported or zero. Editorial comparisons and testing suggestions are labeled as guidance.
Profile pages with limited evidence stay outside the initial indexing set. A listing can be useful for discovery without being ready for an expanded search page.

No aggregate safety, trust or autonomy score is supplied in this release. Future test results should identify the fixture, version, environment, permission policy, evaluator, cost and acceptance result.

title: Suggest a project
body: Help expand the atlas with a source-backed listing. Submit an official URL, entity type, short description and documentation that explains the capabilities.
If the project exposes an MCP server, skill, agent interface or payment integration, include the exact documentation or repository path. Never submit secrets or API keys.
Submissions should enter an editorial review queue. This content package does not implement or activate a submission backend.
success_copy: Suggestion received for review. This is not a published listing.
implementation_note: Use success_copy only after a real successful backend write; otherwise show a disabled form or configured contact route.

title: Suggest a correction
body: Send the profile URL, the specific field that needs changing, the corrected value and a supporting source.
For pricing, include currency, billing interval and whether the price requires an annual commitment. For people or funding, identify the source date and the organization concerned.
Corrections should preserve an internal history of the previous claim and evidence. The public page should reflect the latest reviewed information.
implementation_note: Requires a real submission backend. Do not simulate receipt.
